raw_response:
This is my main plot and maize is our food, so I must take care with it. Here in Mbeya the rains are reliable, and I have seen that my neighbors who use a bag of fertilizer and good seed get much more from their plot. I will buy one bag of CAN or DAP if I can manage it, and use some improved seed from the agro-dealer in town. I do not have money for pesticide, and I will weed with my own hands together with my family, hiring a few people only for the heavy weeding.
